correctness.rationale: Each pointed equivariant map is determined by a parent target plus one right phase per nonzero source-target orbit. Nilpotence equals forest acyclicity; forest gauges erase phases even for nonabelian groups. Orbit-stabilizer has isotropy q^r a(F). A parent-zero image allows zero or q phased root targets, while a parent-nonzero image forces an unphased choice among children, yielding the stated independently verified bottom-up recursion for the entire composition centralizer. The independent exhaustive checker covers cyclic orders 2,3,6 and S3 at small b, but the all-group proof is deductive.

value.rationale: A complete natural monoid invariant for all nilpotent elements, with exact numbers of unit conjugacy orbits, labelled maps per orbit, nilpotency index, image size and full commutant size, not just the previously known total. The uniformity for arbitrary nonabelian finite groups of equal order is a structural consequence of tree gauge normalization. The collision of centralizer sizes among distinct rooted forests provides an exact boundary to what the invariant distinguishes.
